name: Local Field Interpolation with Dynamic Subdivision
aliases: Fast ray tracing of scale-invariant integral surfaces
Local Field Interpolation with Dynamic Subdivision for SCALIS
definition: The paper's proposed approach to reduce the number of field evaluations for SCALIS field ray tracing by relying on local field interpolations and subdividing the ray into intervals that capture main field variations.
summary: Local Field Interpolation with Dynamic Subdivision is a real-time ray tracing pipeline for SCALIS that uses dynamic view-dependent acceleration and local quadratic approximations to efficiently find intersections.
